title: ExternalBindingClaim — the subject asserts the binding
description: Signed by the SUBJECT npub. This is the user saying 'this is mine'. It establishes attribution and intent; it establishes NOTHING about whether the post exists or says what it claims. Only a validator's own fetch does that, which is why the claim and the observation are two artifacts and two signatures and are never merged.

claimedAt.$comment: OPTIONAL and non-authoritative. A subject's own timestamp is a claim about a clock nobody else read.

subjectKey.$comment: the x-only key the npub encodes. Present so a verifier checks the signature without re-deriving it, and REQUIRED to equal the decoded npub payload — EVIDENCE_FOLD.md section 2 step 1.
